title: The War and the Gospel: Sermons and Addresses During the Present War

The text interprets the significance of war through the lens of Christian faith, underscoring themes of hope, redemption, and the enduring presence of the Gospel. Wace emphasizes the notion of Christ as a savior amidst suffering, arguing that true peace can only be realized through a heartfelt connection to Christ's teachings and sacrifices.
